access_policy: research_a/research_b are already-used research data; confirmation, locked and legacy final ranges stay closed this round.

research_a.measurement: Synchronized CUDA; same full input keys; warmup excluded; shared preprocessing reported separately

research_b.measurement: Synchronized CUDA; same full input keys; warmup excluded; shared preprocessing reported separately

calibration.basis: Six archived 10-day baseline fits on research_a/research_b, re-scored from their frozen predictions and evaluation targets; frozen before any 40-day fit.

hypothesis: The 40-day pool failed its worst-day guardrail because old dates diluted the recent regime. Fixed exponential recency weights with a ten-trading-day half-life should keep the 40-day sample but restore the recent-date emphasis, clearing the unchanged promotion gates against the 10-day/1500 reference.

basis.rss_formula: round_up_256(1.25 x measured peak host RSS)
basis.wall_formula: round_up_300(1.25 x (measured preprocessing + 6000 x measured seconds/step) + 300s save/check slack)

notes: Six mandatory 6000-step fits (seed 11 first for the recorded screen, then 29/47). The twelve reused fits are never refitted. The equal-weight control isolates the weighting effect; promotion is still decided against the 10-day reference.
only_factor: per-sample MSE weight none -> 2**(-age/10), age 0 = newest training date, normalized to mean one on the full selected 40-day pool; sampler, batch order, steps, seeds, target_std, network and preprocessing fixed

policy.exposure_policy: Steps, batch size, learning rate and recipe stay fixed for this round; a larger pool gets no extra steps because that would confound coverage with compute.
policy.interpretation_rule: A non-accept result bounds what equal-compute date expansion achieves; it does not establish that more history is uninformative.
policy.primary_metric: paired daily all-eight-time RankIC, seed-mean per day before pairing

statistics.sensitivity_rule: Report both block lengths; conflicting conclusions are inconclusive, and neither is chosen after seeing results.

screen.rule: Seed 11 is screened and reported first, but the round always completes seeds 29 and 47: the registered decision is the three-seed comparison, and seed 11 alone can neither accept nor reject an improvement.

source_delta.note: Only adapter.py and config.py differ from the equal-weight control snapshot; every other training file is byte-identical.
